In my experience, beach morning glory is the ultimate sledgehammer for stopping a psychedelic trip cold and fast.
The leaf is strong enough that even picking one can affect me if the juice from the broken part touches sensitive skin, especially under my fingernails, so I keep my skin away from the broken end.

A whole leaf can easily end the trip and, in my experience, may keep you from tripping for days afterward. A tiny nibble can sometimes smooth psychedelic nausea and even improve the trip without ending it.
But it takes only a little more than a nibble to end the trip, so I use it for nausea only when the person is okay with their trip possibly ending.
I was rushing to help her, so I may have given her more than I would give now.
